name: weed-plugins
description: Weed's Claude Code harness - one repo, per-loop plugins

plugins.name: weed-harness
plugins.description: Core harness infra - setup, harness-sync, skill-subscribe, find-skills, workflow-plan, hooks and HUD

plugins.name: matt-loop
plugins.description: Matt loop - matt-auto (conductor for Matt Pocock's main flow with a decision delegate and a single confirm before tickets publish) plus the vendored Matt Pocock skills it conducts (auto-synced from mattpocock/skills; kept in sync at ~/.codex/skills by the auto-update hook)

plugins.name: super-loop
plugins.description: Superpowers-based development loop - gated brainstorm/plan/execute/verify/finish cycle (requires the superpowers plugin)
